input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Response.__init__ reads self.raw.reason to initialize reason, but raw has no underlying response object yet at construction time, so the attribute access dereferences None.
- failure path: Any call that builds a Response, such as every adapter.send or a plain Response(), raises AttributeError ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'reason') before the object is populated, so no request can complete.

Reviewer finding
- description: Constructing a Response now raises AttributeError because self.raw is initialized to None before this assignment.
- rationale: Any call to Response(), including the normal HTTP response construction path, reaches self.raw.reason before a transport response has been assigned to raw. Accessing reason on None raises AttributeError, preventing requests from returning responses.
critique: The finding and the label describe the same fault. Response.__init__ accesses self.raw.reason while raw is None at construction, which raises AttributeError and breaks every Response construction path.
